title: Faster AI Replies
summary: The user asked Baymax how to make its responses faster. Baymax explained that brief pauses occur because it takes time to think in order to provide the best care for the user.

messages.text: ouhh, why you will take longer time to response sometime?
Sometimes I need a bit more time to process things carefully so I can give you the best and safest answers, ya. Thank you for being so patient with me!

archived_messages.text: how to let you reply faster?
